records.title: Validated GC-MS quantification of selected Cannabis terpenes
records.extraction: Ethyl acetate extraction with n-tridecane internal standard
records.validationFramework: Method optimized and validated against reference standards with AOAC-oriented validation
records.quantificationContext: Quantification of selected terpenes in cannabis plant material
records.notes: Validated for the named analytes in the study. Do not extend validation automatically to terpene identities not included in the reference-standard panel.

records.title: Review of cannabis cannabinoid and terpene analytical methodologies
records.matrix: Cannabis sativa and derived analytical matrices
records.technique: GC, HPLC, GC×GC and associated extraction/sample-preparation approaches
records.validationFramework: Methodology review describing advantages, drawbacks, and matrix effects
records.quantificationContext: General analytical-method context rather than one validated compound panel
records.notes: Used as system-level analytical context only. It does not provide compound-specific method validation by itself.

records.title: Cannabis FET-HS-GC/MS-TOF quantification including cis-(Z)-β-ocimene
records.technique: Full evaporation technique headspace gas chromatography with time-of-flight mass spectrometry (FET-HS-GC/MS-TOF)
records.extraction: Headspace full evaporation technique with high equilibration temperature and no conventional solvent extraction
records.validationFramework: 35-terpenoid standard panel; reported method accuracy >90% and 5 ppm limit of detection for all analytes
records.quantificationContext: Quantitative cannabis volatile profiling across THC-dominant and CBD-dominant chemotypes; cis-β-ocimene explicitly reported among quantified major terpenoids
records.notes: PubChem identifies cis-β-ocimene as the (3Z)-β-ocimene identity used by this reviewed chapter. This record does not establish E/trans-β-ocimene method coverage.

records.title: Cannabis GC-MS reference-standard identification of α-terpinene and γ-terpinene
records.matrix: Cannabis sativa whole or milled flowers from 33 chemovars
records.technique: Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) targeted terpene metabolomics
records.extraction: Cannabis volatile-profile sample preparation used in the study's targeted metabolomics workflow
records.validationFramework: Purchased Cannabis Terpene Mix A reference standards; peak confirmation using external standards analyzed under the same GC conditions and retention-index comparison
records.quantificationContext: Targeted profiling and identification of cannabis monoterpenes and sesquiterpenes across 33 chemovars
records.notes: Supports reviewed analytical identification context for α- and γ-terpinene. It is not represented here as a universal cannabis laboratory validation for every quantitative matrix or instrument configuration.

records.title: Validated gas-liquid chromatographic measurement of squalene in human biological matrices
records.matrix: Human plasma, feces, urine, bile, and tissue
records.extraction: Mild saponification followed by alumina column chromatography; recovery standard used to correct losses
records.validationFramework: Accurate and reproducible method with reported recoveries above 80% in tissues and 96% in plasma
records.quantificationContext: Quantitative squalene measurement in biological matrices
records.notes: Validated for human biological matrices, not Cannabis. It establishes a reviewed squalene analytical method but does not imply cannabis-matrix validation.

records.title: Single-laboratory validated reversed-phase LC determination of total and all-trans β-carotene
records.matrix: Dietary supplements and β-carotene raw materials
records.technique: Reversed-phase liquid chromatography using C18 or C30 columns
records.extraction: Matrix-dependent protease digestion and dichloromethane-ethanol extraction or direct dissolution of oily suspensions
records.validationFramework: Single-laboratory validation with linearity, precision, recovery, and separation of all-trans, 9-cis, 13-cis, and 15-cis β-carotene
records.quantificationContext: Quantitative total and all-trans β-carotene analysis across supplement and raw-material matrices
records.notes: Validated for supplement/raw-material matrices, not Cannabis. The method is useful analytical context and demonstrates geometric-isomer separation without implying cannabis-matrix validation.
